reason: The book is already positioned exactly as a contrarian-turnaround book should be the day before a live FOMC print: 42% cash and only 58% gross exposure, so the binary risk is already sized down rather than something I need to trade my way out of. Fresh research confirms rather than undermines the two conviction legs -- ADBE (now ~$261.6, above its 257.26 re-entry) is riding a real, dated catalyst (a rotation out of AI-hardware names into established software following industry slowdown warnings, plus DA Davidson lifting its target to $290) and CRM (~$258, above its 249.12 entry) has its own fresh AI-product news (the Koa reasoning model) and an Evercore Outperform reiteration -- so trimming winners into strength the day before a Fed decision would be selling exactly the thesis that's working. The three macro/hedge legs (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, IWM, GLD) are all soft but within their stops (BTC -2.5% off entry vs a -15% stop, IWM -3% vs -8%, GLD -1.5% vs -8%) and each is a plausible beneficiary of a dovish surprise tomorrow, so keeping them intact preserves two-sided optionality around the print instead of betting the book on a single outcome. A full replacement here would pay real bps of churn to reshuffle a book that is already +13.10% since inception and already defensively sized, for no informational edge -- the FOMC outcome isn't knowable today, and any repositioning I could do now is dominated by simply waiting for the 2026-09-16 close, which already reflects the decision. Existing stop-loss/take-profit levels on every leg remain sensible unchanged, so I am holding rather than trading.
